verdict: Paid campaigns went dark 13 days ago; leads have stopped completely.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 44 leads at $24.88 per lead — but all of that activity came in the first half of the window. Paid ads have been off since August 6th, and the last three days have produced zero spend and zero leads. Google Business Profile engagement has also dropped sharply in the same stretch, so organic activity is softening alongside paid. Campaigns are being reactivated this week to restore lead flow. You should expect leads to resume once spend is live again; the cost-per-lead baseline of $24.88 gives us a clear target to work back to.
